description.html: The 50W Arcadia Solar Basking Spotlight is the lowest-wattage option in the series, ideal for smaller terrariums and species that need moderate heat at the basking spot. It produces focused heat and visible light, simulating natural sunlight.

Place it on one side of the terrarium to create a temperature gradient - a warmer basking zone and a cooler zone for resting. The E27 socket allows easy installation in standard ceramic holders. We recommend using it with a thermostat for precise temperature control.
Arcadia is a renowned British brand known for quality reptile lighting.
